name: Fear-funding composite with RSI-oversold timing leg (mechanical confirm)
rationale: Adds a price-mechanical oversold leg to the positioning+sentiment composite to sharpen entry timing. Arm a long when funding is soft (below ceiling, uncrowded) AND Fear&Greed is fearful AND RSI is below an oversold floor — the fear/funding gauges supply the contrarian REGIME, RSI supplies the precise oversold TIMING on price. All three BOUNDED/mean-reverting; RSI lt floor is the correct level op for a bounded oscillator; funding ceiling straddles realized to bite (null carry crowding filter). The thesis: an oversold price reading that COINCIDES with both positioning softness and sentiment fear is a higher-quality dip than oversold alone, which often keeps falling. DISCONFIRMER: an RSI-only oversold long (no fear, no funding) is in this cohort — if RSI-alone matches the deflated/holdout Sharpe, the fear and funding legs are redundant with price and add no orthogonal information beyond classic oversold mean-reversion, so the composite is not earning its complexity. Exit on RSI normalizing OR sentiment recovering. Holdout must hold. Gate disposes; honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: soft funding + fear + RSI oversold coincide
